title: External image subtitle files (.sup, .sub/.idx) and VobSub as a file
description: List and draw external PGS and VobSub files like the embedded ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Drawn into a transcode; PGS sent to jellyfin-web when its setting is on
notes: External .sup and .sub/.idx files beside the film, POSIX and S3, listed as Jellyfin 12.4 lists them (compat/captures/external-image-subtitles-12.4.md); a .sup goes to jellyfin-web as the file with its PGS setting on, else both are drawn into a transcode by a worker. A file ffprobe refuses or finds no packets in is hidden on its first burn. Two attempts: the first left damaged files unhidden.
